name: io.github.dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile
title: ARWP Site Resolver
description: Read-only MCP resolver for public websites. It normalizes ARWP plus existing web, API, agents.txt/json, A2A, Agent Skills and experimental MCP discovery into an evidence-backed service map and deterministic intent plans. A site does not need to publish an ARWP profile.
